digest.component_or_area: LLM provider integration and model target resolution
propositions: Pydantic AI 1.107.2 emits PydanticAIDeprecationWarning when rebar uses the ambiguous openai: prefix because v2 semantics will change it from Chat Completions to Responses.
Rebar's _pai_model and model_classes._resolve_target functions compose and emit the ambiguous openai: prefix for inferred, configured, and legacy-explicit OpenAI targets.
Custom endpoint routing failed when explicit openai-chat: targets were used because ProviderSession.cfg.base_url builder and per-candidate endpoint guards matched only the legacy openai name.
The operator-approved fix normalizes all rebar-owned OpenAI target construction to explicit openai-chat: while preserving existing Chat Completions wire semantics and custom-endpoint compatibility.

This repair eliminates the announced v2 deprecation warning, treats openai and openai-chat as compatible provider spellings, and keeps the future openai-responses: migration as a separate tracked story.
